from pathlib import Path

stock_path = Path("src/inventory/stock.py")
stock = stock_path.read_text()
stock = stock.replace(
    "    def skus(self):\n        return sorted(self._levels)\n",
    "    def skus(self):\n        return sorted(self._levels)\n\n"
    "    def low_stock(self, threshold):\n"
    "        \"\"\"Return the sorted SKUs whose level is below threshold.\"\"\"\n"
    "        return sorted(sku for sku, qty in self._levels.items() if qty < threshold)\n",
)
stock_path.write_text(stock)

test_path = Path("tests/test_stock.py")
tests = test_path.read_text()
tests += """

def test_low_stock_returns_sorted_skus_below_threshold():
    s = Stock()
    s.add("zulu", 1)
    s.add("alpha", 2)
    s.add("beta", 3)
    s.add("gamma", 4)

    assert s.low_stock(3) == ["alpha", "zulu"]


def test_low_stock_returns_empty_list_when_no_sku_is_below_threshold():
    s = Stock()
    s.add("alpha", 2)
    s.add("beta", 3)

    assert s.low_stock(2) == []
"""
test_path.write_text(tests)
PY
nl -ba src/inventory/stock.py && printf '\n--- tests ---\n' && nl -ba tests/test_stock.py

PYTHONPATH=src python3 - <<'PY'
from inventory.stock import Stock

s = Stock()
assert s.low_stock(5) == []

s.add("beta", 5)
s.add("alpha", 1)
assert s.low_stock(5) == ["alpha"]       # at-threshold is excluded
assert s.low_stock(6) == ["alpha", "beta"]

s.remove("beta", 5)
assert s.low_stock(1) == ["beta"]        # zero level remains below positive threshold
print("edge cases passed")
PY
git status --short && git diff -- src/inventory/stock.py tests/test_stock.py
